text: The tracks table has duplicates: different track_ids can be the same real-world track.
Duplicate tracks need not match exactly (e.g. different year formats or small attribute differences), so they are resolved by comparing title, artist, album, year and so on.
The sales table records sales in five countries: USA, UK, Canada, Germany and France.
Sales occur on five platforms or stores: iTunes, Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and Google Play.
